programs=base/'programs'; programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    groups = {}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); stack.append((ny,nx))
            groups.setdefault(color, []).append(cells)
    # The two color groups occupy neighboring columns in the packed output.
    colors = sorted(groups, key=lambda col: min(x for obj in groups[col] for _,x in obj))
    widths = {col: max(max(x for _,x in obj)-min(x for _,x in obj)+1 for obj in groups[col]) for col in colors}
    x_offsets = {}
    x_offsets[colors[0]] = 0
    if len(colors) > 1:
        x_offsets[colors[1]] = widths[colors[0]] + 1
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for color in colors:
        objects = groups[color]
        # Objects farther right in the input are placed above the leftmost object.
        objects = sorted(objects, key=lambda obj: min(x for _,x in obj))
        lower, upper = objects[0], objects[-1]
        lower_height = max(y for y,_ in lower)-min(y for y,_ in lower)+1
        upper_height = max(y for y,_ in upper)-min(y for y,_ in upper)+1
        lower_top = h-lower_height
        upper_top = lower_top-upper_height-1
        for obj, top in ((lower, lower_top), (upper, upper_top)):
            min_y = min(y for y,_ in obj); min_x = min(x for _,x in obj)
            for y,x in obj:
                yy = top + y-min_y
                xx = x_offsets[color] + x-min_x
                out[yy][xx] = color
    return out
'''
